run_generate_nocache: run generate_nocache to produce token completions from prompts using a ByteLatentTransformer model with top-k or top-p sampling
run_launch_generate: run launch_generate to load a consolidated BLT checkpoint and generate text completions for a list of prompts
run_sample_top_k: run sample_top_k to sample the next token from a probability tensor using top-k sampling strategy
run_sample_top_p: run sample_top_p to sample the next token from a probability tensor using nucleus top-p sampling strategy
run_get_generation_range: run get_generation_range to compute the start and end positions for token generation given prompt tokens and max generation length
